findings.summary: The "Adding a new language extractor" guide still instructs contributors to build a "call-graph second pass for INFERRED calls edges," which is the exact anti-pattern this task just fixed (and contradicts the EXTRACTED/"a direct call" example three lines above it at line 53). Not in the brief's stated scope (extract.py + tests), but it will actively mislead the next extractor author back into re-tagging direct calls as INFERRED.
